fields.description: #146 decision 13: <fbpi_order_nr>-<n>, n = 1 + every shipment ever created on this order (including cancelled ones) - never reused.
fields.label: Integration Shipment Nr

fields.description: #146 review finding #2: Discarded is a local-only recovery state (no Noon call), available from Error or Cancel Pending, that releases the shipment's claimed units.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Created
Cancel Pending
Cancelled
Error
Discarded

fields.description: Set by Mark Handed Over (#368): when the units were recorded as handed over. No Noon call is made.
fields.label: Handed Over On

fields.description: The draft Delivery Note Mark Handed Over created for this shipment (#368). A second click creates none while it exists and is not cancelled. Deleting the Delivery Note clears this field.
fields.label: Delivery Note

fields.description: Every Delivery Note created for this shipment (#368), as a JSON list. The first one is also in Delivery Note. A retry adds rows to the first note while it is a draft and starts a new draft only once it is submitted.
fields.label: Delivery Notes

fields.description: Handed-over units that could not be put on a Delivery Note and are still unresolved (#368): a JSON list. While this is set the order stays in Needs Action. Cleared only when the units are drafted, or the shipment is cancelled or discarded.
fields.label: Unresolved Handover Units

fields.description: When the unresolved handover units were first recorded (#368).
fields.label: Unresolved Since

fields.description: Private PDF attachment uploaded by the user; sent to Noon as raw base64 (#146 decision 19). Never used as evidence of a real ERPNext accounting document.
fields.label: Invoice File

fields.description: frappe.generate_hash(length=32), saved before the UploadShipmentInvoice call and reused on retry; a deliberate re-upload gets a fresh key (decision 19).
fields.label: Invoice Idempotency Key

fields.description: #146 review 'new problem': kept separate from the shipment-level last_error so an invoice failure and a shipment (create/cancel) failure never overwrite each other on the same field.
fields.label: Invoice Last Error
